# Sandesh Gadal

> Backend and IoT developer in Bharatpur, Chitwan, Nepal (UTC+5:45). Builds Laravel and MySQL backends, React front ends, and the integrations where physical devices send data into them. Available for full-time, contract and freelance work, remote or on-site in Chitwan.

This site is a single page, prerendered at build time, so its HTML at https://www.sandeshgadal.com.np/ carries the full content without JavaScript.

## Now

- Project Manager / Lead Developer, Hexa Labs (Apr 2026 – present): leading an automatic milk collection system where the analyser at the collection centre tests a sample and the reading goes straight into the database.
- Backend Developer, Loopix Creations (May 2025 – present, part-time): architecting an MIS platform; Laravel REST APIs; MySQL query tuning.

## Selected work

- [Aabhaa](https://github.com/Sandesh-Gadal/Aabhaa): farming assistant combining local weather, crop recommendations and soil NPK readings. Android client in Java on a Laravel API and Firebase.
- Digital Journal Publication System (Oxford College): submission, peer review, editorial decisions and publication for an academic journal. React on Laravel and MySQL.
- [NFC E-Attendance](https://github.com/Sandesh-Gadal/eAttendance): students tap an NFC card and a Laravel REST API records attendance in MySQL, with per-class and per-student reports.
- [Chitwan Computer](https://chitwancomputer.com.np): storefront and product catalogue with a Laravel admin panel the owners update themselves.

## Skills

- Daily: PHP, Laravel, MySQL, REST API design, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Git, IoT device integration.
- On real projects: Node.js, PostgreSQL, Docker, Linux, Firebase, Java (Android), NFC readers.
- Learning: Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, AWS, CI/CD pipelines.
